verdict.rationale: The evidence only indirectly supports this story. Carta documents an Investor API for investment firms (carta-docs-15) and an endpoint that lets fund operators retrieve summary cap table insights for their portfolio holdings (carta-docs-24), so investors can pull holdings data without going through the founder. A community remark that Carta contacts all of a company's investors (carta-comm-8) suggests investors are linked to the platform. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an investor-facing portal or holdings view, a structured founder-to-investor update feature, and hands-on corroboration of how investors actually see their positions.
